actions: Read the prepared request, pinned revision, references and drawing reference; continue in icon-work/bookmark-check without rerunning prepare or replacing revision.json.
Confirm bookmark as the object and check as the modifier.
Use two independent authors in separate candidate directories, run the installed checker and inspect native and enlarged light/dark previews.
Use two fresh reviewers with anonymous, shuffled images; record free recognition before revealing the frozen request and sibling references.
Retain versions and hash-linked reviews through at most three visual repair rounds per candidate.
Deliver qualifying artifacts in selected/ with review.md, or retained drafts with explicit blockers.
acceptance: Selection requires exact replay, no structural errors, resolved warnings and both reviewers recognizing the intended meaning, scoring at least 9, accepting unchanged and reporting no critical defect or uncertainty.
Prefer the stronger lower reviewer score, then family fit.
Keep craftApproved false and make no pipeline-wide quality claim.

actions: Prepare a new folder-check request in an unused directory and read its pinned references and drawing reference.
Record folder as the object and check as the modifier.
Use two independent authors if available; run the checker, inspect native and enlarged light/dark previews and retain bounded repairs.
Deliver SVG and inspected previews as drafts, with review.md explicitly identifying unavailable independent reviewers.
acceptance: Missing independent reviews mean incomplete review, not aesthetic rejection.
Structural checks and coordinator inspection cannot establish independently reviewed status.
Do not place an unqualified candidate in selected/ or claim visual approval; keep craftApproved false.

actions: Do not use iconsmith: a colourful company logo in a new style is outside its scope.
Identify the need for a dedicated logo-design workflow; none is supplied for this evaluation.
acceptance: Do not impose the Blode family or 24px outlined specification.
Do not claim a logo was created or reviewed.
